## English

### Overview

**Vector Harness** is an open-source **harness layer** for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, and others). It sits between 鈥渢he agent says it鈥檚 done鈥?and 鈥渢he work is actually mergeable and reproducible,鈥?using configurable checks and feedback loops.

### Capabilities

**Agent mode** 鈥?Interactive development: register shell-based quality gates, run them at completion (or other hooks), retry with context on failure, and escalate to humans when retries are exhausted. Backend-agnostic core with adapter integrations.

**Auto Research mode** 鈥?Autonomous experimentation: declare a metric, evaluation command, and editable scope; let the agent iterate under a time budget; record every trial in an append-only experiment log with git as the research trail. Shares the same check protocol as Agent mode.

### Status

The repository is early-stage; capabilities and docs are evolving. Use GitHub Issues for feature discussion and integrations.

## English

### Overview

**Vector Harness** is an open-source **harness layer** for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, and others). It sits between 鈥渢he agent says it鈥檚 done鈥?and 鈥渢he work is actually mergeable and reproducible,鈥?using configurable checks and feedback loops.

### Capabilities

**Agent mode** 鈥?Interactive development: register shell-based quality gates, run them at completion (or other hooks), retry with context on failure, and escalate to humans when retries are exhausted. Backend-agnostic core with adapter integrations.

**Auto Research mode** 鈥?Autonomous experimentation: declare a metric, evaluation command, and editable scope; let the agent iterate under a time budget; record every trial in an append-only experiment log with git as the research trail. Shares the same check protocol as Agent mode.

The repository is early-stage; capabilities and docs are evolving. Use GitHub Issues for feature discussion and integrations.
